briefTitle: A Study of IDE034 in Adult Participants With Locally Advanced/Metastatic Solid Tumors Types

typedChecks.sourceText: Participant must be at least 18 years of age or the age of maturity per local regulations
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Participant must be at least 18 years of age or the age of maturity per local regulations

typedChecks.sourceText: Have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) of 0 or 1.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) of 0 or 1.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with advanced recurrent or metastatic solid tumors expressing B7-H3 and PTK7 in the following indications: NSCLC, ESCC, endometrial cancer, HGSOC, HNSCC, TNBC (estrogen receptor, progesterone receptor, and human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 [HER2] negative), CRC, and CRPC who have radiologically progressed or recurred on at least one line of therapy or is intolerant to additional effective standard therapies.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Biomarker expression requirements for B7-H3 and PTK7 across various tumor types are not standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Archival tissue sample for testing
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Tissue sample availability is a procedural requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have adequate bone marrow and organ function.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General organ function without specific lab cutoffs is a fuzzy clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known symptomatic brain metastases or leptomeningeal metastasis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic brain metastases are not a clean typed brain_mets category of none, treated_stable, or untreated.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known primary CNS malignancy and any other malignancies within 2 years prior to the first dose.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of other malignancies is not a typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have uncontrolled tumor-associated pain
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled pain is a subjective clinical symptom.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have clinically significant cardiac abnormalities and/or cerebrovascular disease (stroke) within 6 months before the first dose
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Significant cardiac abnormalities and cerebrovascular disease are clinical judgments.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Active uncontrolled infection
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Uncontrolled infection is a clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have history of interstitial pneumonitis, current noninfectious pneumonitis requiring steroid therapy; known or suspected interstitial pneumonitis as seen on screening imaging; other moderate to severe lung diseases seriously affecting respiratory function within 3 months before the first dose.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pneumonitis and lung disease criteria are complex clinical conditions not captured by typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have history of severe infections within 4 weeks prior to the start of study treatment, including but not limited to bacteremia, severe pneumonia, or other serious infectious complications requiring hospitalization.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Severe infection history with hospitalization is a complex clinical history rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have history of immunodeficiency, with a positive human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) test at screening.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV status is not a typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with known or suspected viral hepatitis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Viral hepatitis status is not a typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have history of active tuberculosis within 1 year before enrollment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Tuberculosis history is not a typed check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: If participants had adverse reactions to previous antitumor treatment that have not recovered to guidelines of CTCAE Grade ≤ 1 and Grade 2 peripheral neurological symptoms
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Recovery from prior toxicity is a clinical grading assessment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received chemotherapy within 3 weeks of first dose of IMP; immunotherapy or biologic targeted antitumor treatments within 3 weeks before the first dose of IMP or other investigational products within 4 weeks of first dose of IMP
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex washout rules for multiple drug classes are not simple lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Current use or anticipated need for food or drugs that are known strong CYP3A4/5 inhibitors or inducers
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Concomitant medications for CYP3A4/5 are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have prior treatment with a topoisomerase I inhibitor (TOP1i), including an ADC with a TOP1i payload, within 6 months of first dose of IMP
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy exclusion with specific timing and payload class cannot be expressed as a simple prior_therapy_excluded check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received radiotherapy within 2 weeks prior to study entry
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Radiotherapy washout is not a simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have undergone major surgery or trauma within 4 weeks prior to study entry.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgery washout is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have received live attenuated vaccine within 28 days prior to the first dose or are expected to receive live attenuated vaccine during the study treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Live vaccine washout is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Female participants who are pregnant, lactating, or planning to become pregnant during the study period to 7 months after the last dose of IMP.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy and lactation status are not typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Are known to be allergic to any component or excipient of the IMP product or have a history of severe allergic reactions to other monoclonal antibody/fusion protein drugs.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Allergy history is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Participants with complications in the eye including ulcers in the eye, and severe dry eye
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Eye complications are not typed checks.
